newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Afghan provincial governor said shot dead.
newsitem.headline: Afghan provincial governor said shot dead.

text.p: The governor of Afghanistan's opposition-held northern province of Samangan, Maulvi Abdul Quddus Rehmani, was shot dead on Monday in the northern town of Mazar-i-Sharif, a Pakistan-based opposition spokesman said on Tuesday.

Maulvi Abdul Baqi Turkestani, spokesman for the opposition Jumbish-i-Milli northern movement, told Reuters that Rehmani was shot by unknown people at about 3 p.m. (1030 GMT) in the city's Darwaza-i-Tashqurghan area.
There was no immediate information about the motive of the killing.
Samangan is one of several northern provinces controlled by the alliance fighting the Taleban movement, which controls more than two-thirds of the country.
